name: Bochtóg
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: woke those who slept on the shore
a beautiful woman with waist-length blonde hair

text: Bochtóg is an Irish heroine. A fairy woman saved people from drowning. She woke sleepers on the shore as the tide rose. That wakeful act saved them from the sea. She was seen in rough weather. When visible she was a beautiful woman. Her waist-length hair was blonde.

okr.objective: Describe Bochtóg, the fairy who woke sleepers on the shore.
key_results: Bochtóg was an Irish fairy woman.
She woke those who slept on the shore as the tide rose.
She appeared as a beautiful woman with long fine hair.
